Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Always the first field in a FIX message. Valid value: FIX.4.2

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Always the second field in a FIX message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Always the third field in a FIX message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Default is N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party sending the message. The sending Firm uses its Line Identifier as assigned by MIAX Pearl Equities.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party sending the message.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission in UTC. Must be within a configurable interval of the current time, else the order is rejected. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.mmm

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party receiving the message. Firms use the value as assigned by MIAX Pearl Equities.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party receiving the message. Required for all application messages from Firm to MIAX Pearl Equities. Valid values: TEST = MIAX Pearl Equities TEST Env., PROD = MIAX Pearl Equities PROD Env.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Applicable to application messages. N = new message (Default), Y = application level resend, which is not supported: the message is logged but effectively ignored.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Required for all application messages from Firm to MIAX Pearl Equities. The NSCC MPID of the Firm who owns the order sent in the message.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Any 4 character string provided by the Firm. Could be used to identify a specific entity or trading desk of the Firm.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for resent messages. If no data is available, this value is set to the SendingTime value. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.mmm

Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Always the first field in a FIX message. Valid value: FIX.4.2

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party sending the message. Same value the Firm sends in TargetCompID.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party sending the message. Required for all application messages from MIAX Pearl Equities to Firm. Valid values: TEST = MIAX Pearl Equities TEST Env., PROD = MIAX Pearl Equities PROD Env.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission in UTC. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.mmm

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party receiving the message. Same value the Firm sends in SenderCompID.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party receiving the message.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Applicable to application messages. Set to Y during certain failure/recovery scenarios.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for resent messages. If no data is available, this value is set to the SendingTime value. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.mmm

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: The NSCC MPID sent in OnBehalfOfCompID from the Firm is sent back.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: The value sent in OnBehalfOfSubID by the Firm is sent back.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always the last field of a FIX message.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Encryption is not supported and this field is ignored.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds. Must be greater than 0 and the same value used by both sides.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates both sides of a FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Test request identifier to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: First message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Last message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: Required if reject reason refers to a specific tag.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional information regarding the reject.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a gap fill.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Readable information about the logout.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer ID defined by the firms. Passed through for clearing.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day unique identifier of the order as assigned by the firm. Must be unique across all open orders for the session within a matching engine.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Execution instructions.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares specified on the order.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type. Valid values: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit, P = Pegged. Pegged requires ExecInst = M, m, R or r.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price for limit orders and pegged orders. Required for limit orders and pegged orders. Should not be specified on market orders.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell, 5 = Sell Short, 6 = Sell Short Exempt.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The equity symbol.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the order was initiated/released expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Directed firm code for directed order flow.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum fill quantity.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Maximum displayed quantity for a reserve order. The balance is reserve.

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: Indicates whether the broker is responsible for locating stock for a short sale.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Time of order expiration for GTD orders.

Field.Name: PegOffset
Field.Description: Offset from the pegged reference price for pegged orders.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the firm for this order. Valid values: A = Agency, P = Principal, R = Riskless Principal.

Field.Name: LocateAccount
Field.Description: Account used for the locate.

Field.Name: PurgeGroup
Field.Description: Optional Trading Participant specified purge group value.

Field.Name: SelfTradeProtection
Field.Description: Self-trade protection group value.

Field.Name: PriceSlidingAndRepriceFrequency
Field.Description: Price sliding and re-price frequency. Valid values: D = Display Price Sliding, Re-price Once (Default for displayed orders), C = Display Price Sliding, Re-price Once, but Cancel if Crossed at Entry, M = Display Price Sliding, Reprice Multiple Times, N = No Price Sliding.

Field.Name: DisplayRange
Field.Description: Random replenishment display range around Max Floor for reserve orders.

Field.Name: MinQtyExecType
Field.Description: MinQty execution type. Applicable when MinQty is non-zero. Valid values: 1 = Only single contra order can fulfill MinQty requirement (Default when MinQty is specified), 2 = Multiple contra orders can fulfill MinQty requirement.

Field.Name: RoutingInst
Field.Description: Routing instruction. Valid values: O = Route Once, R = Re-routable, N = Do Not Route. Default is Do Not Route for Midpoint Peg, Primary Peg, Minimum Quantity, Post Only and ISO orders; else default is Route Once.

Field.Name: RoutingStrategy
Field.Description: Routing strategy for the order.

Field.Name: TradingCollarDollarValue
Field.Description: Custom Dollar Value for Trading Collar Protection.

Field.Name: DisplayIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the order is displayed or non-displayed.

Field.Name: RetailOrderIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates a retail order.

Field.Name: AttributableIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates whether the order is attributable.

Field.Name: CancelOrderIfNotNBBOSetter
Field.Description: Cancel the order if it does not set the NBBO.

Field.Name: CancelOrderIfNotNBBOSetterWithSize
Field.Description: Valid values: Y = If not NBBO Setter with Size, order will be cancelled back, N = If not NBBO Setter with Size, order will not be cancelled back (Default).
